description: Empirical round-trip-efficiency curve vs C-rate (1-D lookup). Derived from the cell ohmic loss fraction I*R/V_nom; numbers reused from F1a.
source: Chen et al. (2020), J. Electrochem. Soc., 167, 080534; Samsung INR21700-50E datasheet

efficiency_curve.description: Round-trip efficiency tabulated over C-rate breakpoints; eta = (1-f)/(1+f), f = C*capacity*R/V_nom.

c_rate.note: max continuous C-rate for this chemistry
